notes.title: Version 1.3 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Added hit markers when hitting enemies.
2. Implemented a mini-map system.
3. Fixed an issue where enemy AI would get stuck when players were in partially elevated areas.
4. Adjusted the appearance of BOSS enemies to match the current number of players in the session (this will be the first step in updating the pace of battles).
5. Revised the scoring system for killing enemies; now both BOSS and special enemies have fixed scores, making the scoring system more reasonable (due to an overall increase in scores, prices for some door openings have been slightly raised).
6. Reduced muzzle flash for some weapons, minimizing the disturbance of the flash during first-person gameplay.

notes.title: Update to V1.2
notes.notes:
1.Added new optional characters.
2.Added character selection saving function, which automatically selects the last used character.
3.Various weapon performance and user experience slightly adjusted.
4.Player stamina limit slightly increased.
5.Increased interval rest time between rounds, and random weapon crates can be quickly opened.
6.Bloodstain texture bug fixed, now visible to all players globally.
7.Victory sound effect overlapping playback bug fixed.

notes.title: V1.1 Update Notes
notes.notes:
1. Optimized the issue of enemy numbers growing too fast and becoming overwhelming in multiplayer mode.
2. Lowered the price of weapon crates so that players joining mid-game can access them right from the start.
3. Significantly enhanced the performance of the starting rifle.
4. Slightly increased the damage of rifle, machine gun, and shotgun weapons.
5. Reduced the duration of zombie corpses to optimize performance.
6. Slightly decreased the movement speed growth rate of Sprinting Demons.
7. Slightly reduced the HP growth rate of Strong Demons.
8. Slightly decreased the attack power of regular zombies.
9. Fixed bugs in the snow map.

notes.title: "Bunny Guntz" is now on sale!
notes.notes:
After several rounds of testing and polishing, "Bunny Guntz" has been updated to the official version and is now on sale with a 15% off discount in the first week.

The game also plans to continue to add content and mechanisms, and the details of continued optimization will be continuously updated and improved after it goes online.
